attendance_policy: Students are expected to attend all the classes & tutorials, and take part in at least 50% of the participation linked assessments, in both lecture as well as tutorials.
makeup_policy: Make-ups are generally considered only for medical emergencies leading to hospitalization (or a personal emergency of similar nature). For a foreseen absence, make-up request should be made personally by meeting the Instructor-in-Charge. Reasons for unanticipated absence that qualify one for make-up include medical or similar personal emergencies only. In such cases, the Instructor-in-Charge must be informed either by email or telephone, at the earliest. Please note that there would be no exclusive makeup for a quiz. There would be one common makeup for all the three quizzes, towards the end of the semester. The decision by the Instructor-in-Charge regarding granting makeups shall be final.
